design: F10 cross-ancestry SENSITIVITY feasibility check (European BMD instruments -> non-European OA outcome)
outcome: Genes & Health British South Asian OA excl. spine (GCST90727231, n=44026)
verdict: UNINFORMATIVE: exome-wide sequencing does not capture the common regulatory variants used as European BMD instruments (1/31 matched). No MR estimate produced; does NOT close F10 and must NOT be reported as a result.
